BiblicalUsage: The elect are chosen unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ. We are come to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the sprinkling is the heart of the covenant, because blood sprinkled is blood applied. Abel's blood cried for vengeance from the ground, but the blood of Jesus speaks better things, and its word is mercy. I hold that no one is sprinkled by accident: the blood is put where the person is, and the person is made clean where the blood is put.
